output.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::int AS revenue_year, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
output.explanation: Revenue is summed from net_revenue in marts.fct_orders, restricted to orders flagged is_revenue = true, and grouped by the calendar year of order_date. The result is rounded to 2 decimals and sorted by year.
